hypothesis: Single source of truth eliminates contradictory P&L

diagnosis: The optimization is stuck in a local optimum of "instructional refinement." All 10 rounds of mutations have focused on reinforcing a single negative constraint (the "Single Formula Law") by adding more warnings, examples of what not to do, and audits to catch violations. This has made the skill incredibly dense with prohibitions but has not provided sufficient positive guidance on the core architectural change required. The root cause of failure is not a misunderstanding of the *rule*, but a failure to execute the complex *refactoring* of `run-trading-chain.ts` to eliminate the paper book logic. The mutations have been treating the symptom (rogue P&L formulas) instead of the disease (the continued existence of the paper book code that generates them). The AI is being told "don't use this broken part" instead of being shown how to remove the broken part and what to replace it with.

The optimization is stuck in a local optimum of "instructional refinement." All recent mutations have focused on reinforcing a single, complex negative constraint (the "Single Formula Law") by adding more warnings, more examples of what *not* to do, more reminders, and more verification steps. The skill has reached peak instruction density; adding more text is increasing cognitive load without improving compliance. The AI understands the rule but fails to apply it perfectly across a complex, multi-file refactoring task. The mutations are treating the symptom (the AI makes an error) rather than the root cause (the task is structured as a high-stakes, multi-step derivation from a complex rule, which invites error).
